VADER for MPC OS 3.x (Akai Force / MPC), armv7: an orbit-based vector synth. Unzip, then follow INSTALL.md (root SSH access, e.g. MockbaMod).
`VADER-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` is the plugin, with example shapes in its `Shapes` folder. How to use it: [the user guide](https://github.com/sunskiefer/VADER/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md).
Tested on a device when listed in tested.json (a pre-release until then). See CHANGELOG.md for what changed.
